meta.description: Watches #integration-alerts for Zoom Cloud Recording Completed messages tagged with the GLTH Sales & Marketing Meeting, parses meeting name + duration + recording URL, signs the JSON body with HMAC-SHA256 using GLTH_ZOOM_SECRET, and POSTs to clawos. The clawos webhook watcher (slug: glth-zoom-recording) queues an ops mission_task that pulls the transcript, finds the meeting Google Doc, and pushes action items to ClickUp.
